jd:
Data Engineer - Cobalt Meadow Insurance

About the role
Cobalt Meadow is modernising its analytics stack. You will build and run the pipelines that feed underwriting dashboards. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain batch data pipelines
- Model data for reporting
- Monitor pipeline health

Requirements
- Python for data processing
- Advanced SQL
- Apache Airflow
- Apache Spark
- AWS data services
- Data modeling

Nice to have
- dbt
- Kafka

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
